verdict.rationale: Deployment environments with approval gates are a fair axis for a Git forge that ships CI/CD (Gitea Actions), so the story applies. The evidence only shows generic GitHub Actions-compatible workflows and third-party integrations such as Argo CD. Nothing documents environment definitions, approval gates, or tracking which change is deployed where.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define deployment environments with approval gates and track which change is deployed where
